name: Quietly
tagline: Automatic phone profiles: when you reach the office, go silent. At night, Do Not Disturb.
description: Quietly changes your phone's settings for you. Make rules like "when I'm on the office Wi-Fi, set the ringer to vibrate", "from 23:00 to 07:00, turn on Do Not Disturb" or "when my car's Bluetooth connects, set media volume to 70%". Conditions: Wi-Fi network, time and weekdays, headphones, a Bluetooth device, charging and low battery. Actions: ringer mode, Do Not Disturb, media and ring volume, screen brightness, open an app, or show a notification. When two rules clash, the one higher in your list wins, and Quietly puts your old settings back when a rule stops. It runs in the background, starts after a reboot, and has a Quick Settings tile to pause everything. Everything stays on your phone.
